import ctypes
import sys

# Load GSL libraries with correct order and dependencies
cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl_lib = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define necessary GSL types and constants
class gsl_qrng(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("state", ctypes.c_void_p),
                ("type", ctypes.c_void_p),
                ("dimension", ctypes.c_uint)]

GSL_SUCCESS = 0
SOBOL_MAX_DIMENSION = 40

# Look up the Sobol generator type and function symbols
gsl_qrng_sobol = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl_lib, "gsl_qrng_sobol")
gsl_qrng_alloc = gsl_lib.gsl_qrng_alloc
gsl_qrng_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint]
gsl_qrng_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_qrng)
gsl_qrng_get = gsl_lib.gsl_qrng_get
gsl_qrng_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_qrng), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)]
gsl_qrng_get.restype = ctypes.c_int
gsl_qrng_free = gsl_lib.gsl_qrng_free
gsl_qrng_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_qrng)]

def generate_sobol_sequence(dimension, count):
    if dimension < 1 or dimension > SOBOL_MAX_DIMENSION:
        raise ValueError("Dimension must be between 1 and 40")
    if count < 1:
        raise ValueError("Count must be at least 1")
    
    # Allocate and initialize the Sobol generator
    qrng_ptr = gsl_qrng_alloc(gsl_qrng_sobol, dimension)
    if not qrng_ptr:
        raise RuntimeError("Failed to allocate Sobol generator")
    
    try:
        result = []
        array_type = ctypes.c_double * dimension
        for _ in range(count):
            vec_array = array_type()
            status = gsl_qrng_get(qrng_ptr, vec_array)
            if status != GSL_SUCCESS:
                raise RuntimeError(f"gsl_qrng_get failed with status {status}")
            result.append(tuple(vec_array[i] for i in range(dimension)))
        return result
    finally:
        gsl_qrng_free(qrng_ptr)

def assert_test():
    # Test basic functionality
    seq = generate_sobol_sequence(2, 5)
    assert len(seq) == 5, "Incorrect number of vectors"
    assert all(len(v) == 2 for v in seq), "Incorrect dimension"
    assert all(0.0 <= x <= 1.0 for v in seq for x in v), "Values out of range [0,1]"
    
    # Test first vector values (Sobol sequence starts at 0.5, not 0.0)
    first_vec = seq[0]
    assert abs(first_vec[0] - 0.5) < 1e-10 and abs(first_vec[1] - 0.5) < 1e-10, "First vector incorrect"
    
    # Test second vector values - corrected expected values
    second_vec = seq[1]
    assert abs(second_vec[0] - 0.75) < 1e-10 and abs(second_vec[1] - 0.25) < 1e-10, "Second vector incorrect"
    
    # Test third vector values for additional verification
    third_vec = seq[2]
    assert abs(third_vec[0] - 0.25) < 1e-10 and abs(third_vec[1] - 0.75) < 1e-10, "Third vector incorrect"
    
    # Test error handling
    try:
        generate_sobol_sequence(0, 1)
        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError for dimension 0"
    except ValueError:
        pass
    
    try:
        generate_sobol_sequence(41, 1)
        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError for dimension 41"
    except ValueError:
        pass
    
    try:
        generate_sobol_sequence(1, 0)
        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError for count 0"
    except ValueError:
        pass
    
    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
